note: Seth Ji ke Case. The founder approves each case (approved: true) before it is played live. WhatsApp list rows: clue labels and options at most 24 characters. 'answer' is the correct option's text. Medical cases are famous moments from history, told as stories - never advice.

cases.title: Haveli ka Raaz
cases.brief: Seth Dawood raat 10 baje apne kamre mein mare paye gaye - chai mein zeher tha. Us waqt haveli mein teen log the: bawarchi Rahim, bhatija Kamran aur munshi Aslam. Teeno kehte hain: 'Main kamre ke qareeb bhi nahi gaya.'
cases.question: Qatil kaun hai?

clues.label: Chai ki pyali
clues.text: Chai 9:30 pe Rahim ne banayi, magar tray kamre ke darwaze ke bahar rakh ke chala gaya. Andar koi aur le gaya.

clues.label: Kamran ka bayan
clues.text: Kamran 9 se 11 baje tak dost ki shadi mein tha. 50 mehmanon ne usay wahan dekha.

clues.label: Munshi ke joote
clues.text: Munshi ke jooton pe laal qaleen ka resha mila - woh qaleen sirf Seth sahab ke kamre mein bichha hai.

cases.explain: Kamran shadi mein tha, Rahim ne tray bahar chhori. Munshi ke jooton pe kamre ke qaleen ka resha tha - yaani woh andar gaya tha.

cases.title: Gumshuda Haar
cases.brief: Shadi ke ghar se dulhan ka sone ka haar ghaib ho gaya - dopahar 2 se 3 baje ke beech, jab bijli gayi hui thi. Us kamre mein teen log gaye the: darzan Shabana, photographer Bilal aur cousin Hina.
cases.question: Haar kis ne churaya?

clues.label: Bilal ka camera
clues.text: Camera mein 2:05 se 2:55 tak lagataar tasveerein hain - sab bahar lawn ki, baraat ki.

clues.label: Shabana ka bayan
clues.text: Shabana: 'Main ne almaari ke sheeshe mein Hina ko haar uthate dekha.' Magar bijli band thi aur us kamre mein khirki nahi.

clues.label: Hina ke haath
clues.text: Hina 2 baje se mehndi lagwa rahi thi - dono haath geeli mehndi se bhare the.

cases.explain: Andhere kamre mein sheeshe mein kuch nahi dikhta - Shabana ne jhoot bola. Bilal lawn mein tha aur Hina ke haath mehndi mein the.

cases.title: Jahaz ki Beemari
cases.brief: Saal 1747. Aap ek samandari jahaz ke doctor hain. Mahinon se safar jaari hai. Mallahon ke masoorhon se khoon aa raha hai, daant hil rahe hain, purane zakhm phir khul rahe hain. Khane mein sirf sukha gosht aur biscuit hain.
cases.question: Mallahon ko kya dein?

clues.label: Khane ki fehrist
clues.text: Mahinon se jahaz pe koi taza phal ya sabzi nahi aayi.

clues.label: Afsaron ki haalat
clues.text: Jin afsaron ke paas apne nimbu rakhe the, woh bilkul theek hain.

clues.label: Doosre jahaz
clues.text: Jo jahaz bandargah pe ruk ke taza phal lete hain, un ke mallah chand din mein theek ho jate hain.

cases.explain: Yeh scurvy thi - Vitamin C ki kami. Dr James Lind ne 1747 mein yahi tajurba kiya; isay tareekh ke pehle medical tajurbon mein gina jata hai.

cases.title: London ka Nalka
cases.brief: Saal 1854, London ka Soho mohalla. Das din mein 500 log ulti aur dast se mar gaye. Sab kehte hain 'gandi hawa' se beemari phail rahi hai. Aap Dr John Snow hain aur aap ko shak hai.
cases.question: Wabaa kahan se phail rahi hai?

clues.label: Mauton ka naqsha
clues.text: Zyada tar mautein Broad Street ke ek hi nalke ke ird gird ke gharon mein hui hain.

clues.label: Karkhane ke mazdoor
clues.text: Paas ke karkhane ke 70 mazdoor apne kuein ka paani peete hain - un mein ek bhi beemar nahi.

clues.label: Door ki khatoon
clues.text: Meelon door rehne wali ek khatoon bhi mar gayi. Usay isi nalke ka paani pasand tha - roz mangwati thi.

cases.explain: Dr Snow ne nalke ka handle utarwa diya aur wabaa ruk gayi. Yeh haiza tha, jo gande paani se phailta hai - yahin se wabaon ki science shuru hui.

cases.title: Chashm-deed Gawah
cases.brief: Aap ke muakkil pe ilzaam hai ke us ne raat 11 baje dukaan ka taala tora. Gawah Jameel kehta hai: 'Main ne apni khirki se saaf dekha - chaand ki roshni mein. Yehi aadmi tha.'
cases.question: Gawahi mein kya ghalat hai?

clues.label: Us raat ka calendar
clues.text: Waardaat ki raat amavas thi - aasman pe chaand tha hi nahi.

clues.label: Gali ki batti
clues.text: Gali ka bulb do hafte se toota hua hai. Shikayat darj hai.

clues.label: Khirki ka faasla
clues.text: Jameel ki khirki dukaan se 80 gaz door hai.

cases.explain: Amavas ki raat 'chaand ki roshni' mein 80 gaz door se chehra pehchanna namumkin hai. Abraham Lincoln ne 1858 mein isi daleel se ek muqadma jeeta tha.

cases.title: Wasiyat ka Kaghaz
cases.brief: Adalat mein Seth sahab ki wasiyat pesh hui: tareekh 14 August 1995, sari jaidad naukar ke naam. Beta kehta hai wasiyat naqli hai. Aap bete ke wakeel hain.
cases.question: Wasiyat naqli kaise sabit hogi?

clues.label: Kaghaz ka nishaan
clues.text: Kaghaz pe mill ka watermark hai - aur woh mill 2003 mein khuli thi.

clues.label: Gawah
clues.text: Wasiyat ke dono gawah wafaat pa chuke hain - un se poochha nahi ja sakta.

clues.label: Stamp ka ticket
clues.text: Stamp paper pe jo ticket laga hai, woh design 2001 mein jaari hua.

cases.explain: Tareekh 1995 ki, magar kaghaz 2003 ki mill ka aur ticket 2001 ka. Jo kaghaz us waqt bana hi nahi tha, us pe wasiyat kaise likhi gayi?

cases.title: Aakhri Over
cases.brief: Final ka aakhri over. Mukhalif team ko 8 run chahiye. Crease pe Zaheer hai - 70 run bana chuka, poori tarah set. Aap ke paas teen bowler bache hain.
cases.question: Gend kis ko dein?

clues.label: Zaheer ka record
clues.text: Zaheer spinner ko maidan se bahar maarta hai. Magar yorker pe pichle 6 match mein 5 dafa out hua.

clues.label: Maidan ki os
clues.text: Bohat os gir rahi hai - spinner ke haath se gend phisal rahi hai.

clues.label: Naseem ka din
clues.text: Naye tez bowler Naseem ne aaj 2 over mein 5 no-ball phenki hain.

cases.explain: Os mein spinner bekaar, Naseem no-ball de raha hai. Aur Zaheer ki kamzori yorker hai - Hassan hi sahi faisla.

cases.title: Toss ka Faisla
cases.brief: Semi-final, din-raat ka T20. Aap toss jeet gaye. Aap ki team ka sab se bara hathyar aap ke do spinner hain. Poora stadium aap ke faisle ka muntazir hai.
cases.question: Toss jeet ke kya karenge?

clues.label: Raat ki os
clues.text: Is maidan pe raat ko bohat os girti hai - doosri innings mein gend geeli ho jati hai.

clues.label: Maidan ka record
clues.text: Pichle 10 match mein 8 dafa baad mein batting karne wali team jeeti.

clues.label: Aap ke spinner
clues.text: Geeli gend spinner se grip nahi hoti. Sukhi gend se yehi dono match palat dete hain.

cases.explain: Pehle bowling: spinner sukhi gend se bowling karenge, aur os mein hadaf ka taaqub aasan hoga.

cases.title: Dono Engine Band
cases.brief: January 2009, New York. Udaan bharne ke 2 minute baad parindon ka jhund jahaz se takraya - dono engine band. Jahaz mein 155 log hain. Aap Captain hain aur faisle ke liye chand second hain.
cases.question: Jahaz kahan utarenge?

clues.label: Bulandi
clues.text: Sirf 2,800 foot. Baghair engine ke jahaz chand minute hi hawa mein reh sakta hai.

clues.label: Wapis LaGuardia
clues.text: Wapis murhne mein bulandi kam par jayegi - aur raaste mein gunjaan imaratein hain.

clues.label: Teterboro airport
clues.text: 11 kilometre door. Hisaab kehta hai jahaz wahan tak nahi pohanch sakta.

cases.explain: Captain Sullenberger ne jahaz Hudson darya pe utaar diya - 155 ke 155 log bach gaye. Duniya isay 'Miracle on the Hudson' kehti hai.

cases.title: Tel Khatam
cases.brief: Saal 1983, Canada. 12,000 metre ki bulandi pe jahaz ka tel khatam ho gaya - tel bharte waqt kilo aur pound ka hisaab ghalat laga tha. Dono engine band, 69 log sawar.
cases.question: Jahaz kahan utarenge?

clues.label: Winnipeg ka faasla
clues.text: Winnipeg airport 120 km door. Hisaab kehta hai jahaz 20 km pehle zameen pe aa jayega.

clues.label: Gimli airbase
clues.text: Purana fauji airbase sirf 20 km door hai. Co-pilot wahan kaam kar chuka hai - runway jaanta hai.

clues.label: Jheel
clues.text: Jheel ka paani barf jaisa thanda hai - musafiron ko bachana bohat mushkil hoga.

cases.explain: Asal waqia: Air Canada ki flight 143. Pilot ne jahaz Gimli ke purane airbase pe utaara aur sab bach gaye - isay 'Gimli Glider' kehte hain.

cases.title: Imarat mein Aag
cases.brief: Paanch manzila imarat ki teesri manzil pe aag lagi hai. Chauthi manzil pe 6 log phanse hain. Aap ki team pohanch gayi hai aur sab aap ke hukm ke muntazir hain.
cases.question: Pehla hukm kya hai?

clues.label: Lift
clues.text: Aag mein lift kabhi istemal nahi hoti - bijli jate hi beech mein phans jati hai.

clues.label: Seerhiyan
clues.text: Seerhiyon mein zehreela dhuan bhar chuka hai - do minute mein insaan behosh ho jata hai.

clues.label: Balcony
clues.text: Chauthi manzil ki balcony sarak ki taraf khulti hai - seerhi wali gaari wahan tak pohanchti hai.

cases.explain: Lift phans sakti hai aur seerhiyon mein zehreela dhuan hai. Balcony se seerhi wali gaari hi mehfooz raasta hai.

cases.title: Sailaab ka Faisla
cases.brief: Sailaab aaya hua hai. Aap ki kashti mein sirf 6 logon ki jagah hai aur teen jagah se madad ki pukaar aa rahi hai: masjid ki chhat pe 20 log, ek kache ghar mein 5 log, aur ek darakht pe ek jawan.
cases.question: Kashti pehle kahan jayegi?

clues.label: Masjid
clues.text: Pakki imarat hai. Paani abhi chhat se 6 foot neeche hai aur wahan khana maujood hai.

clues.label: Kacha ghar
clues.text: Deewaron mein dararein par chuki hain - ghante bhar mein gir sakta hai. Andar 2 bachay aur ek buzurg hain.

clues.label: Darakht
clues.text: Mazboot darakht hai aur jawan ne khud ko rassi se baandh rakha hai.

cases.explain: Masjid aur darakht wale abhi mehfooz hain. Kacha ghar girne wala hai aur us mein bachay aur buzurg hain - sab se pehle wahi.

cases.title: Tijori ki Chori
cases.brief: Raat ko bank ki tijori se 50 lakh ghaib ho gaye. Taala toota nahi - tijori chaabi se kholi gayi. Chaabi sirf teen logon ke paas hoti hai: cashier Tariq, guard Nawaz aur assistant Sana.
cases.question: Chor kaun hai?

clues.label: CCTV
clues.text: Raat 1:10 pe camera 4 minute ke liye band hua. Us ka switch guard room mein hai.

clues.label: Tariq
clues.text: Tariq ek hafte se Lahore mein chhutti pe hai - ticket aur hotel ka record maujood.

clues.label: Sana ki chaabi
clues.text: Sana ki chaabi kal shaam se locker mein jama hai - register mein dastakhat hain.

cases.explain: Tariq Lahore mein tha, Sana ki chaabi jama thi. Camera guard room se band hua - aur wahan sirf Nawaz tha.

cases.title: ATM ka Daawa
cases.brief: Ek sahab aap ke paas aaye: 'Mera ATM card kal raat 9 baje Karachi mein chori hua aur chor ne 9:30 pe 50,000 nikal liye. Mujhe paise wapis chahiye.'
cases.question: Aap ka faisla kya hai?

clues.label: ATM ka record
clues.text: 9:30 pe paise Lahore ke ek ATM se nikle - Karachi se nahi.

clues.label: PIN
clues.text: Pehli hi koshish mein sahi PIN laga.

clues.label: Phone ka record
clues.text: Un sahab ka apna mobile 9:30 pe Lahore ke tower pe tha.

cases.explain: 9 baje Karachi mein chori hua card 9:30 pe Lahore nahi pohanch sakta. PIN pehli dafa sahi laga aur un ka apna phone bhi Lahore mein tha.

cases.title: Viral Tasveer
cases.brief: WhatsApp pe ek tasveer viral hai: 'Aaj Karachi mein barf bari!' Aap ka reporter kehta hai fauran chhaap dein - sab se pehle hamari khabar hogi. Aap Editor hain.
cases.question: Sach kya hai?

clues.label: Aaj ka mausam
clues.text: Aaj Karachi ka darja hararat 31 degree hai.

clues.label: Tasveer ki talaash
clues.text: Yehi tasveer 2016 mein bhi internet pe maujood hai - Murree ke naam se.

clues.label: Dukaan ka board
clues.text: Tasveer mein ek dukaan ke board pe 'Mall Road, Murree' likha hai.

cases.explain: 31 degree mein barf nahi parti. Tasveer 2016 ki hai aur board pe Murree likha hai - purani tasveer ko naya naam de diya gaya.

cases.title: Zalzale ki Afwah
cases.brief: Raat 9 baje ek message har group mein ghoom raha hai: 'NASA ne kaha hai aaj raat 12 baje Karachi mein zalzala aayega - sab log bahar soyein.' Log ghabra ke daftar phone kar rahe hain.
cases.question: Akhbaar kya karega?

clues.label: Science
clues.text: Duniya ka koi idara zalzale ka din aur waqt pehle se nahi bata sakta.

clues.label: NASA ki website
clues.text: NASA ne aisa koi bayan jaari nahi kiya.

clues.label: Message ki tareekh
clues.text: Yehi message 2019, 2021 aur 2023 mein bhi ghoom chuka hai.

cases.explain: Zalzale ka waqt koi nahi bata sakta, NASA ne kuch nahi kaha, aur yehi message barson se ghoom raha hai. Akhbaar ka kaam afwah rokna hai.

cases.title: Teen Musafir
cases.brief: Airport pe khufia ittila aayi hai: aaj ki flight se ek musafir sona chhupa ke la raha hai. Shak teen logon pe hai: taajir Rafiq, talib-e-ilm Usman, aur wheelchair pe Mrs. Khan.
cases.question: Sona kis ke paas hai?

clues.label: Rafiq ka bag
clues.text: Rafiq ke chhote se bag ka wazan 14 kilo nikla - kapron ka bag itna bhari nahi hota.

clues.label: Usman ka bag
clues.text: Scanner mein sirf kitabein aur ek laptop nazar aaya.

clues.label: Wheelchair
clues.text: Wheelchair airline ki apni hai - musafir ke saath nahi aayi.

cases.explain: Usman ke bag mein sirf kitabein thin aur wheelchair airline ki thi. Chhote bag ka 14 kilo wazan - sona bohat bhari hota hai.

cases.title: Kelon ka Container
cases.brief: Bandargah pe ek container aaya. Kaghzaat mein likha hai: 'Ecuador se kele - 20 din ka safar.' Maalik jaldi mein hai aur kehta hai maal kharab ho jayega, fauran chhor dein.
cases.question: Aap ka hukm kya hai?

clues.label: Darja hararat
clues.text: Container ka fridge band hai, andar 35 degree. Kele is garmi mein 20 din nahi chal sakte.

clues.label: Wazan
clues.text: Kaghzaat mein 18 ton likha hai - kaante pe 26 ton nikla.

clues.label: Sniffer kutta
clues.text: Customs ka kutta container ke pichle hisse ke paas baith gaya - yeh us ka ishara hai.

cases.explain: Fridge band, wazan 8 ton zyada aur kutte ka ishara - andar kele nahi, kuch aur chhupa hai.

cases.title: Mughal Sikka
cases.brief: Ek sahab museum mein 'Akbar badshah ke daur ka chandi ka sikka' bechne aaye hain. Qeemat 20 lakh maang rahe hain. Aap Curator hain - faisla aap ka hai.
cases.question: Sikka asli hai ya naqli?

clues.label: Sikke pe san
clues.text: Sikke pe '1580' angrezi hindson mein likha hai. Mughal sikkon pe Hijri san Farsi mein hota tha.

clues.label: Kinara
clues.text: Kinare pe machine ke barabar daane hain - yeh tareeqa sadiyon baad aaya.

clues.label: Wazan
clues.text: Asli Mughal rupay se 3 gram halka hai.

cases.explain: Angrezi hindse, machine wala kinara aur kam wazan - teeno nishaniyan batati hain ke sikka baad mein banaya gaya.

cases.title: Darbar ki Tasveer
cases.brief: Ek painting museum ko pesh ki gayi: 'Mughal darbar ka manzar - san 1650 mein bani.' Bechne wala 1 crore maang raha hai aur kehta hai aaj hi faisla karein.
cases.question: Painting ke baare mein sach kya hai?

clues.label: Rang ka test
clues.text: Lab ne bataya: neela rang 'Prussian blue' hai - yeh rang 1704 mein ijaad hua.

clues.label: Tasveer ka manzar
clues.text: Ek darbari ki kalai pe ghari bandhi hai. Kalai ki ghari 1650 mein nahi hoti thi.

clues.label: Frame
clues.text: Frame ki lakri nayi hai - magar frame toh baad mein badla bhi ja sakta hai.

cases.explain: Jo rang 1704 mein bana aur jo ghari sadiyon baad aayi, woh 1650 ki tasveer mein nahi ho sakte. Naya frame toh sirf bahana tha.
